dedupe_keys.name: earthing soil data for grid and primary sites

description: Earthing Soil Data for Grid and Primary Sites is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction The soil dataset includes multi-layer soil resistivity values for geographic locations near Grid and Primary substations. This data can be used in substation earthing system design. For further information on earthing refer to UK Power Networks' earthing standard EDS 06-0001 available from our website. Please send any enquiries related to the dataset to earthingenquiries@ukpowernetworks.co.uk. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Supporting Information. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
